tasks.label: WW: P-47 replay checks
args: python -B tools/test_coupled_climb_trajectory.py; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; python -B tools/verify_p47_candidate_sync.py; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: WW: Deterministic flight simulation
args: $gradleRoot = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.gradle\wrapper\dists\gradle-8.8-bin'; $gradle = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $gradleRoot -Filter gradle.bat -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $gradle) { Write-Error 'Gradle 8.8 is not cached'; exit 127 }; & $gradle.FullName --no-daemon --console=plain runFlightSimulation; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: WW: Build
args: $gradleRoot = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.gradle\wrapper\dists\gradle-8.8-bin'; $gradle = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $gradleRoot -Filter gradle.bat -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $gradle) { Write-Error 'Gradle 8.8 is not cached'; exit 127 }; & $gradle.FullName --no-daemon --console=plain build; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: WW: Headless dogfight_mutual + verify
args: $gradleRoot = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.gradle\wrapper\dists\gradle-8.8-bin'; $gradle = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $gradleRoot -Filter gradle.bat -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $gradle) { Write-Error 'Gradle 8.8 is not cached'; exit 127 }; & $gradle.FullName --no-daemon --console=plain runGameTestServer '-PflightTestAircraft=warfare_wings:a6m' '-PflightTestScenario=dogfight_mutual'; $gradleStatus = $LASTEXITCODE; python -B tools/verify_mutual_dogfight_scenario.py --root run-gametest --gradle-status $gradleStatus --output run-gametest/scenario-verification-dogfight_mutual-local.json; $verifyStatus = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($gradleStatus -ne 0) { exit $gradleStatus }; exit $verifyStatus
